description:
FILED s463au (agent AU, round 20).  These are the THREE PREREQUISITES #960
half (a) â perl's refusal for a binary operation on an overloaded object â
turns out to need, each measured rather than guessed, and they are why that
half was DECLINED this session (see #960's own SIZED-AND-DECLINED section).

The refusal itself is small.  What makes it unsafe TODAY is that PCL's
overload model is incomplete in ways that would turn "wrong but running" into
"dead" for programs perl runs fine.

=== 1. `nomethod` IS IGNORED ===

    package NoM; use overload '0+' => sub { 7 }, nomethod => sub { "NOMETHOD" };
    my $x = NoM->new; $x + 2;        perl NOMETHOD     PCL 9

perl consults the `nomethod` key exactly when no handler and no autogeneration
apply â i.e. at the SAME point the refusal fires.  A class with `nomethod` is
a class that has told perl "call me instead of dying", so a refusal that does
not read the key would kill it.  p-find-overload already finds the key (it is
an ordinary *p-overload-table* entry); nothing calls it.  perl passes a FOURTH
argument, the operator string: handler($self, $other, $swapped, $op).

=== 2. THE BITWISE OPS HAVE NO OVERLOAD DISPATCH AT ALL ===

    package Baz; use overload q/|/ => sub { "y" };
    bless([], "Baz") | "x"           perl y            PCL 8

`p-bit-and` / `p-bit-or` / `p-bit-xor` (and `p-<<` / `p->>`) coerce with
to-number/p-string-bit-op and never ask `%with-binary-overload`, which every
arithmetic and string op goes through.  THIS IS WHERE #960(a)'s OWN ROWS ARE:
perl-tests/bop.t 462-465 are four blessed baseline fails and all four are this
family â

    bop.t 462  string overload can't use |     (needs the REFUSAL)
    bop.t 463  correct error                   (needs the REFUSAL's message)
    bop.t 464  | overload works        '8' want 'y'   (needs the DISPATCH)
    bop.t 465  |= doesn't break string overload '9' want 'z'

so shipping the refusal alone would move 462/463 while 464/465 stayed wrong
for the other reason.  The dispatch is the additive half and should go first.

=== 3. `""` IS NOT DERIVED FROM `0+` (and the compound op string is lost) ===

    package Ncmp; use overload '<=>' => sub {0}, '0+' => sub {1};
    my $x = Ncmp->new; $x . "z"      perl 1z    PCL Ncmp=HASH(0x1)z

perl's MAGIC AUTOGENERATION derives the conversion operators from one another,
so a class with `0+` stringifies through it.  This matters to the refusal
because `.` and `x` are the two binary ops perl AUTOGENERATES (from `""`) and
therefore never refuses â the refusal's own boundary depends on getting the
conversion set right.

And the message: perl names the COMPOUND operator (`Operation "+="`), while
PCL's `+=` reaches the overload dispatch through `%p-compound-+-slow` -> `p-+`,
which has lost the `+=` spelling by then.

=== WHAT #960(a) LOOKS LIKE ONCE THESE ARE DONE ===

perl's rule, and the exact message shape, both probed 5.40.3 (17 rows):

    Operation "OP": no method found,
    \tleft argument <in overloaded package CLS | has no overloaded magic>,
    \tright argument <same> at FILE line N.

DIES with `0+`+`""` present and no fallback: + - * / % ** & | ^ << >> <=> cmp
atan2 (and the one-argument shape for abs/neg/++/--, which #934 already ships).
DOES NOT DIE: `.` and `x` (autogenerated from `""`).
`fallback => 1` never dies; `fallback => 0` forbids even autogeneration.
The site is `%with-binary-overload`'s fall-through (ONE macro, eight callers)
plus `%def-overloaded-cmp`'s final else, which owns the ==/eq families and
their `<=>`/`cmp` derivation.


=== SHIPPED s464aw (agent AW, round 22, 2026-09-02).  ALL THREE PARTS.
=== The REFUSAL itself is still #960(a)'s and did NOT ship.

PART 2 FIRST (the additive half), AND IT IS TEN KEYS, NOT FIVE.  perl
dispatches every bitwise operator, probed one class per key: `&' `|' `^'
`<<' `>>' `~' and the string twins `&.' `|.' `^.' `~.'.  The five binary ops
and the three string-binary ops go through `%with-binary-overload'; the two
UNARY ones through a new `%with-unary-overload'.

  * `%p-neg''s hand-spelled `neg' lookup moved into that new macro.  It had
    been the ONLY unary dispatch in the runtime, which is precisely why `~'
    and `~.' had none: rule 11 read from the other direction -- there was no
    sibling to copy, so nobody copied one.
  * `p-<<=' / `p->>=' were a SECOND COPY of the shift and the copies
    DISAGREED: the compound form had no clamp, so `my $z=5; $z <<= 70' gave
    5902958103587056517120 where perl and `5 << 70' both give 0.  They
    delegate to `p-<<' / `p->>' now.
  * `use integer' bypasses ALL of it (CL primitives emitted INLINE by
    ExprToCL) -- task #1000, a `Pl/' change.  The other eight compound ops --
    #1001.

PART 1, `nomethod', AND THE DANGEROUS FINDING THE TASK PREDICTED IS REAL AND
ALREADY SHIPPED: #934's `Operation "++"' death KILLS a class that declares
`nomethod'.  perl calls the handler (op=`++', other=undef, swapped=`'') and
DISCARDS its return, leaving the object in place; PCL died.  perl's own
`t/lib/overload_nomethod.t' is 0/3 DIFF on main and 3/3 OK here.

  * `%p-nomethod-binary' at the fall-through of `%with-binary-overload',
    `%with-unary-overload', `%def-overloaded-cmp', `%def-overloaded-str-cmp',
    plus one arm at `%p-incdec-autogen''s refusal (BEFORE the `fallback => 1'
    arm -- probed: a fallback-1 class with a nomethod key gets the call).
  * THE BOUNDARY IS AUTOGENERATION, and it is a macro flag (`:autogenerated'),
    not a guess: `.' and `x' come from `""' and never reach nomethod (probed:
    a class with BOTH concatenates); the `== != < > <= >=' family comes from
    `<=>' and `eq ne lt gt le ge' from `cmp'; the conversions come from each
    other.  Only `p-.' carries the flag today (`x' has no dispatch at all,
    #1005).
  * TWO DIVERGENCES FELL OUT OF THE SAME CODE AND ARE FIXED WITH IT:
      - perl's THIRD argument is `""' (defined) for an ordinary call, not
        undef.  It is THREE-VALUED and every state is observable: `""'
        ordinary, `1' swapped, `undef' = "called as a MUTATOR" (a `+='-family
        key), which PCL never produces.  PCL passed `*p-undef*' for
        not-swapped, so a handler asking `defined $_[2]' saw every call as a
        mutator call.
      - A COMPARISON HANDLER'S RETURN VALUE IS THE OPERATOR'S VALUE.  perl
        does not truthify it (`use overload '==' => sub {"PQR"}' makes
        `$x == 2' answer PQR); PCL wrapped every arm in p-true-p + p-bool and
        returned 1.  `p-bool' moved INWARD in both comparison macros, to the
        two arms that COMPUTE a boolean -- the `<=>'/`cmp' derivation keeps it
        because there perl itself compares -1/0/1 with 0.
  * WHAT IS STILL LOST: the COMPOUND spelling.  `$x -= 1' reaches nomethod
    with op=`-' / swapped=`"' where perl says op=`-=' / swapped=undef,
    because `%p-compound---slow' -> `p--' has thrown the spelling away.  Task
    #1001(b); it is also why #960(a)'s message will say `Operation "-"'.

PART 3, THE CONVERSION DERIVATIONS, AND THE ORDER IS FIXED (perl's
Perl_amagic_call), measured one class per row:
        ""   <- 0+ <- bool        (a `0+'-only class stringifies through 0+)
        0+   <- "" <- bool
        bool <- 0+ <- ""          (0+ WINS: 0+ => 0 with "" => "yes" is FALSE)
  * ONE READING, `%p-conversion-handler', consumed by `box-sv', `box-nv' and
    `%p-true-p-slow'.  ANSWER TO THE TASK'S "where is the conversion set
    computed?": it was computed NOWHERE -- the three sites each asked
    `p-find-overload' for one key and stopped, so there was no derivation to
    unify, only three bare lookups to replace.  It returns TWO values, the
    handler and the op-string to pass it (non-NIL only for `nomethod', the
    one handler perl gives four arguments).
  * `fallback => 0' forbids the derivation (perl DIES there; PCL keeps the
    address form until #960(a) lands with it).  Rule 12: a KEY that is not one
    of the three DIES naming itself.
  * THE SCARY HALF IS REAL AND IT IS PERL: a blessed reference is no longer
    unconditionally TRUE.  Measured across the whole sweep and the whole
    companion: ZERO rows moved for it either way.

BARS MET.  Gate 192/6527 (only the 13 pclxs xs rows).  Full sweep GATE clean,
TOTAL passing 18346 -> 18347 (+1), drops 5 = census, 0 new / 0 fixed.
Companion `--dir op' 221 files with ONE mover (op/bop.t 251/246 -> 252/245),
attributed ROW BY ROW on an 80b715c worktree -- `| overload works' present in
one .fails.tsv and absent from the other, nothing else in the file or the
other 220 -- plus an `--all --quick' leg.  Both baselines edited ROW BY ROW:
`| overload works' leaves fail-baseline by EDIT; `|= doesn't break string
overload' stays a fail with its observed value retagged 9 -> 0 (the
`0+'-from-`""' derivation now numifies the Bar object through its `""'
handler, which is "x" at that point, instead of through its address);
pass-baseline bop.t 252/257 -> 253/256; the companion snapshot spliced with
its cause.  Guard `Pl/t/overload-01.t' 23 -> 34 rows, TEN of the eleven new
rows inverse-verified FAILING on an 80b715c worktree (the eleventh is a
negative: `fallback => 0 forbids the derivation', which passes on both).
RUNTIME-ONLY: no generation bump, no artifact regeneration, corpus cannot
move.  `docs/ir-spec.md' 3.3 + 3.4 carry the hook order, the three-valued
third argument, the comparison-return rule and the derivation table.

WHAT NOT TO RETRY (failed attempts, recorded so the next session does not
repeat them):
  * Adding overload dispatch to `p-<<-int'/`p->>-int' ALONE was considered and
    REJECTED: it makes `use integer' answer inconsistently (`<<' dispatching
    while `|' in the same block does not, because `|' never reaches a runtime
    function).  The honest unit is #1000.
  * Making `p-.''s `:autogenerated' flag CONDITIONAL on `fallback => 0'
    (perl's row 59: a fallback-0 class reaches nomethod for `.' although it
    HAS a `""' handler) was measured and DECLINED: it costs an
    `%p-overload-fallback-of' @ISA walk on every concat with an object
    operand -- the `""'-overload hot path, where version.pm and Text::CSV_PP
    live -- for a shape that occurs in ZERO of the 25 `use overload' files
    across cpan-tests/ + lib/ + perl-tests/, and in perl's t/ only in
    `t/lib/overload_nomethod.t', which the companion does not scan.  Task
    #1006 with the gating idea (ask the fallback only when a nomethod handler
    is present) written down.
  * The first `%def-overloaded-str-cmp` guard row used `bless []`, which made
    it fail on an UNRELATED pre-existing bug (`$aryref x 2' is list
    repetition, #1007).  The fixture is `bless {}` and says why.

RESIDUE FILED, all probed: #1000 (`use integer'), #1001 (the compound
family), #1005 (abs/sqrt/cos/sin/exp/log/atan2/x/! have no dispatch), #1006
(the `=' copy constructor + fallback-0-forbids-`.'), and FOUR PRE-EXISTING
silent-wrongs the review probes turned up, each verified identical on an
80b715c worktree: #1002 (`join' FLATTENS a hash/array-ref argument away --
`join(",",$obj)' is EMPTY for every overloaded object), #1003 (`"$a$a"' --
the same box interpolated twice ADJACENTLY yields one copy), #1004 (a
`++'/`--' handler's return is DISCARDED by perl and STORED by PCL, which
declasses the object; the `%p-incdec-overload' comment asserts the opposite
and is wrong), #1007 (`$aryref x N' is list repetition and loses the
reference).

COVERAGE HOLE, for #993: perl's `t/lib/overload_fallback.t' and
`t/lib/overload_nomethod.t' are not in the companion's scan set (it covers
base class cmd comp io mro op opbasic re run uni), so the feature's own
acceptance tests had never been run -- `overload_nomethod.t' was 0/3 on main.


=== FABLE REVIEW + MERGE (s464, 2026-09-02) === diff read; probes vs perl 5.40.3 on both PCL_OPT paths (ovl.pl 37 rows for #972/#987: 33 identical, the 4 diffs are the declined #960(a) refusal); rebased and merged ff into main (round 22: AW 3d666ea, AX 300d47f); legs on the final tree in DECIDED s464 round-22 record.
subject: the THREE prerequisites of #960(a): nomethod is ignored, the BITWISE ops have no overload dispatch (bop.t 462-465), and "" is not derived from 0+
